item.title: CVE-2026-98432 — Linux Kernel IPv4 TCP Use-After-Free (SYN Retransmission and Request-Migration Race)

Tags: UAF, CWE-416, use-after-free, Linux-kernel, TCP, IPv4, SYN, race-condition, MPTCP, request-migration.
